identity.name: Demo Roseward
identity.background_summary: Stage-bright pilgrim who treats every room like an audition for mercy.

proficiencies.weapons_armor: Simple weapons, light armor, three instruments.

equipment.name: Roseglass Lute
equipment.notes: Focus; must stay polished or Charisma checks at Disadvantage.

equipment.name: Travel Veil Cloak
equipment.notes: Light armor equivalent; Glamour etiquette item.

personality.traits: Flirtatious, generous, chronically late, sincerely protective of soft targets.
personality.bonds: Her troupe; a promised return to the Velvet Marches.
personality.flaws: Cannot refuse an audience; spends coin on looks before rations.
personality.perception_lore: Seen as a pretty distraction until her songs rewrite a fight.

physical_ephemera: Demo Roseward carries stage-light even in daylight: copper-rose hair in controlled chaos, travel cloak cut to move like curtain fabric, lute held like a second spine. She smells faintly of rose oil and road dust. Every gesture is half performance, half kindness.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.flavor: Enough to haul a case, not a warhammer.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.flavor: Footwork from dance floors and alley stages.

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.flavor: Main weapon; apology and invitation in one smile.

soul_architecture: Demo's power lives in attention. Strength and studious minds are average; Dexterity and Charisma carry the build. She wins by making enemies hesitate and allies feel watched over.
skills_narrative: She talks doors open and fights into dances. Stealth is theatrical misdirection more than true invisibility.

vulnerabilities.name: Spotlight Dependency
vulnerabilities.effect: Disadvantage on first attack each combat if no ally can see her.

vulnerabilities.name: Glamour Etiquette
vulnerabilities.effect: If outfit is ruined, Disadvantage on Charisma checks until cleaned or replaced.

vulnerabilities_narrative: Demo needs eyes on her — not only vanity, but how her magic meters courage.

features.title: Class Features
features.body: Bardic Inspiration (d6); Song of Rest; Glamour-flavored cutting words.

features.title: Cultural Quirk
features.body: Aurelline courtesy: refuses to humiliate a defeated foe in public without cause.

shift_triggers: Shift to 'The Whore': if she solves every problem with seduction first.
Shift to 'The Dumb Blonde': on repeated Insight/Investigation failures under stress.
Shift to 'The Noble': when she spends Inspiration to protect someone else.

narrative_lenses.The Whore: Emphasis on body, availability, transactional charm.
narrative_lenses.The Dumb Blonde: Emphasis on missed cues and pretty confusion.
narrative_lenses.The Noble: Emphasis on loyalty, performance-as-shield, chosen family.
